text:
lina: Hey team — Acme POC flagged a billing mismatch. Customer (Tom) says the usage dashboard shows ~18,200 tokens used today but the invoice/charge shows ~25k tokens billed. They also had free trial credits, and spend alerts didn’t fire. Can someone help triage? org: acme-enterprise, invoice: INV-2026-0421
jess: Thanks Lina — can you paste the org_id and a screenshot or the raw usage JSON if available? Also did they have any long streaming sessions or many small requests?

samir: Looking. A couple quick checks: 1) Did they use embeddings + generation in same job? Embeddings bill per embedding unit separately. 2) Are we double-counting streaming chunk tokens in the billing backfill?

lina: Org id: org_aae4b2. Tom attached a small snippet from their dashboard export: ```{"date":"2026-03-20","requests":312,"total_tokens":18210,"billed_tokens":25032}``` — they copied from the UI CSV export. They also show free_credits_balance: 8000 in the account settings.

tom_acme: Hi everyone — we definitely didn’t run huge batches. Most calls are short chat turns (~30–80 tokens). We saw a flurry of retries yesterday after some 429s, but those were handled by our client. We assumed retries were de-duped for billing.

samir: Important: retries are billable if they reach the service. Our logs show a burst of retries between 03:10–03:25 UTC for org_aae4b2; about ~6k extra requests. I'm pulling the request-id list now. Also I see a periodic background job from their side hitting /v1/embeddings concurrently — that could explain separate embedding charges.

jess: Can you paste the internal usage line items? I can present it to Tom. Also why didn’t their spend alert trigger?

billing-bot: (automated) Alert config for org_aae4b2: threshold=$2000, current_month_estimate=$1,850, emails_sent=0. No alert fired because estimate was below threshold at the time of evaluation.

samir: Ok found the reason for the 25k billed_tokens field in CSV: our UI export had a bug with streaming responses where we summed "raw_stream_chunks" instead of final token count for a small subset of model variants. That inflated billed_tokens in exports and the CSV. The backend invoice used the corrected final counts.

lina: So the invoice is right but the UI export is wrong? That matches Tom’s message — they got an unexpected charge because they believed the CSV.

samir: Exactly. The invoice reflects actual billing (final_token_count). The CSV bug made it look higher. I’ve filed ENG-7812 to patch the export and backfill the CSV for affected orgs.

jess: Action items: 1) Samir to share a short note and corrected CSV for Tom + include the list of request-ids and times (ETA 2h). 2) Lina to explain free credits interaction: free credits are applied before billing but may not reduce CSV exported gross token counts (we’ll clarify). 3) Billing ops to confirm no refunds needed.

tom_acme: Appreciate it. If you can confirm whether retries were charged vs just the CSV bug, that’d be helpful. Also can you add an optional spend alert webhook? We didn’t get Slack or PagerDuty alerts when estimate neared threshold.

samir: Verified: about ~4.6k requests were genuine retries that were billed (weird client pattern created duplicate calls). The remaining delta to reach 25k in CSV is from the export bug. I'll attach the list and mark which ones were charged.

billing-bot: (automated) Support ticket created: S-89721, assigned to billing-ops.

lina: Thanks. I’ll send Tom the corrected CSV and the quick explainer on free credits vs invoice. Jess — can you follow up on enabling webhook alerts for their org (sales request)?

jess: On it. I'll spin up a feature request for webhook alerting and get a temporary workaround (email-to-slack integration) set for Acme.

samir: Quick technical note for the engineering team: if you see customers using streaming + client-side retry loops, recommend idempotency keys or client dedupe — retries are billed. Also patch for CSV export will drop raw_stream_chunks aggregation in favor of final_token_count.

tom_acme: Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. 

lina: Closing loop: will update this thread with the corrected CSV and the billing ops confirmation once S-89721 is resolved. :thumbsup:
